seen.cipher: f270: letter dated 'De Rome ce 2 de janvier 1585' signed 'Luigi car. d'Este' (signature read at 3000 px), one paragraph of about 8 lines of unspaced symbols (nomenclator plus alphabet signs) between clear French lines; f232 similar, whole page.
